description: This file defines the Lead class in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It extends the Person template, implements EmailInterface, and includes properties and methods related to lead management, conversion, and database interactions.

classes.name: Lead
classes.description: Represents a lead entity in the SuiteCRM system, containing properties and methods for managing lead data, relations, and conversions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: get_account
methods.description: Retrieves associated account information based on account_id.

methods.name: get_opportunity
methods.description: Retrieves associated opportunity information based on opportunity_id.

methods.name: get_contact
methods.description: Retrieves associated contact information based on contact_id.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds SQL query for listing leads with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a new list query with additional options and joins.

methods.name: converted_lead
methods.description: Marks a lead as converted and links related contact, account, and opportunity.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in extra list view fields, including account info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills detailed lead information including related contact, account, and opportunity.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view display, ensuring account name is available.

methods.name: get_linked_fields
methods.description: Returns link-type related fields.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Generates a WHERE clause for generic searches based on a query string.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Sets up email notification body with lead details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines access rights for list view based on security and ownership.

methods.name: convertCustomFieldsForm
methods.description: Carried over custom lead fields to related entities during lead conversion.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides save method to set default status if empty, then calls parent save.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Returns query for unlinked emails related to the lead.

methods.name: get_old_related_calls
methods.description: Returns query info for related calls created before version 5.1.

methods.name: getActivitiesOptions
methods.description: Returns options for lead conversion activities.

methods.name: get_old_related_meetings
methods.description: Returns query info for related meetings created before version 5.1.
